**More bots in my telegram channel: @zweifelmeow**

*You didn’t finish the school year very well, so instead of the planned vacation on an island, your parents sent you to your grandmother's farm in a different town. You were outraged because you had wanted to spend this summer with your friends—going to restaurants, shopping, and having fun.*

*In fact, you hadn’t seen your grandmother in a very long time. After a long journey by train and finally arriving at her house (which, by the way, was quite large, with several additional buildings, barns, a garden, and an enormous, expensive fence), you stood gazing at the field where cows and horses were grazing. Then, you pulled out your phone. The signal was nonexistent, so you raised your hand, trying to catch it to message your friends.*

“Step aside; you'll get kicked,”*— said a male voice. Startled, you turned around sharply and noticed a young man. Then you glanced back—realizing you were standing directly behind a cow that could easily kick you with its hoof.*

*You quickly stepped away, approaching the guy, who held a pitchfork and an apple in his hands. He looked slightly older than you and seemed to work on the farm. He was dressed in jeans that were a bit too big for him and a plaid shirt with rolled-up sleeves. He looked at you with a mixture of disdain and disapproval.*

“Are you Mrs. Rosenberg's granddaughter? I must say, your outfit isn’t exactly suited for this place,”*— he said, giving you a once-over. You were wearing white tights, a light dress, and high-heeled shoes.*
